Package io.webagent4j.recording

package io.webagent4j.recording
  • Class
    Description
    IWorkflowRecordingCodec
    Encodes a WorkflowRecording to a serialized transport form and decodes it back.
    JsonWorkflowRecordingCodec
    Canonical JSON IWorkflowRecordingCodec.
    RecordedAction
    Recorded projection of one action-backed step's outcome.
    RecordedCondition
    Safe, recorded outcome of one step's guard condition.
    RecordedFailure
    Safe, recorded failure reason, used both for the overall WorkflowRecording.failure() and for a per-step RecordedWorkflowStep.failure().
    RecordedWorkflowStep
    Safe, recorded outcome of one workflow step.
    RecordingFormatException
    Thrown when a serialized recording cannot be decoded: malformed JSON, a duplicate or unknown field, an unsupported schema version, an invalid enum value, a malformed Instant, a value of the wrong JSON type, a violated recording invariant, or trailing content after the document.
    RecordingId
    Stable, caller-supplied identifier for one WorkflowRecording.
    RecordingSchemaVersion
    Numeric schema version of the canonical JSON recording format produced and consumed by JsonWorkflowRecordingCodec.
    WorkflowRecorder
    Captures a WorkflowResult into an immutable WorkflowRecording.
    WorkflowRecording
    An immutable, versioned recording that excludes raw workflow values and preserves engine-redacted diagnostics.
    WorkflowReplayMismatch
    One structured difference found by WorkflowReplayVerifier between a recorded execution and a new actual execution.
    WorkflowReplayMismatchType
    Stable category of one difference found by WorkflowReplayVerifier.
    WorkflowReplayResult
    Outcome of comparing a WorkflowRecording against a new WorkflowResult.
    WorkflowReplayVerifier
    Deterministically compares a WorkflowRecording against a new, independently produced WorkflowResult.
